subject: URGENT: EdgeCache routing change — rollback + DPA addendum required
messages:
From: EdgeCache Support <support@edgecache.io>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Notification: temporary routing change affecting EU egress — immediate action recommended

Hi Markus,

We identified a configuration drift during a routine deploy at 08:43 UTC this morning that caused a small percentage (~2%) of requests from EU regions to be routed through an intermediary node in a non-EU country for approximately 7 minutes. The change was unintentional and related to an urgent patch we rolled for a memory regression.

We've already reverted the change on our side and stepped back the patch to the previous stable build. However, because your DPA with Acme (and other EU customers) requires that EU-origin data remains within EU or specifically authorized processors, we wanted to notify you immediately and provide artifacts for your review.

Attached: egress-change-log.txt, egress-routing-map.pdf

What we can provide immediately on request:
- Full audit trail for the deploy and routing decisions (timestamps & node IDs)
- A signed addendum to the DPA proposing a temporary limited exception process + mitigations (if you need it to present internally)
- SOC2 access logs and a packet-level egress summary for the effected window

Next steps we suggest: we can rollback the deploy to the pre-patch state permanently, ship a separate hotfix with stricter routing policy, or produce a DPA addendum for your legal team to review.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this is sensitive. Please tell us what evidence you need and whether you require an immediate rollback.

Regards,
Amir Patel
SRE, EdgeCache Inc.
support@edgecache.io

---
Attachment stub: egress-change-log.txt (text), egress-routing-map.pdf (diagram)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, support@edgecache.io
Date: 2026-10-01T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Notification: temporary routing change affecting EU egress — immediate action recommended

Kimberly / Laura —

Thanks for the heads up Amir.

Laura: can you confirm whether this triggers an immediate customer notification obligation under our standard DPA? Acme's legal (Amelia Ross) is cc'd on this thread; they asked for a heads-up.

Kimberly: from an infra side, please coordinate with EdgeCache to ensure the rollback is recorded and that we receive the promised artifacts (audit trail, packet summary). We should also validate there was no log leakage to non-EU processors. If EdgeCache cannot provide the audit evidence within 24 hours we should consider requiring an ad hoc DPA addendum and pause routing to that partner for EU traffic.

I want a concise list of deliverables we will need to satisfy Acme and our internal compliance:
- Deploy audit + node IDs and timestamps (EdgeCache)
- Packet egress summary (EdgeCache)
- Confirmation of permanent rollback and hotfix timeline (EdgeCache)
- Internal impact analysis: sessions potentially affected, customer accounts flagged (Laura)
- Draft DPA addendum (Legal/Contracts) — if required we can ask EdgeCache to sign one immediately

I will loop in Amelia after we have the artifacts.

-Markus

Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Amelia Ross (Security, Acme Corp) <amelia.ross@acme.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, support@edgecache.io
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Notification: temporary routing change affecting EU egress — immediate action recommended

Markus / team,

Thank you for the quick notification. Acme's position: we appreciate the proactive revert, but we need clear evidence that no customer PII left EU jurisdiction during the interval. At minimum we require:

1) Per-request egress header logs for the 08:36–08:50 UTC window (anonymized to request IDs is fine)
2) A concise incident timeline and root cause explanation
3) Confirmation that EdgeCache will not make autonomous routing changes without prior coordination for EU traffic — if that needs a contractual amendment, we're open to a short addendum language for rapid signature

If you can provide a DocuSign-ready addendum draft we can fast-track review. In parallel we will notify our internal privacy team.

Best,
Amelia Ross
Head of Security & Privacy
Acme Corp.

---
(This is a customer security contact; do not share unnecessary internal notes)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: support@edgecache.io, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, amelia.ross@acme.com
Date: 2026-10-02T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Notification: temporary routing change affecting EU egress — rollback confirmed + DPA addendum draft attached

Amir / EdgeCache team —

Thanks for the rapid follow-up. We reviewed the artifacts you provided in the linked Drive folder; good to see the full deploy timeline and the node list. Confirmed actions:

- Permanent rollback to build 2026-09-29.
- Hotfix with stricter geo-routing policy scheduled for 2026-10-05 (staged rollout; we will keep EU-only flag enabled).
- EdgeCache provided per-request egress headers for 08:36–08:50 UTC (anonymized) and a packet egress summary.

Conditional next steps from Redwood:
- We need a signed DPA addendum for the specific case of transient routing errors that explicitly requires notification within 2 hours and limits cross-border egress to defined escalation criteria. I attached our proposed language (proposed-dpa-addendum-v1.docx) — please review and mark any objections. We will insert a DocuSign link once we agree on language.
- Please provide SOC2 Type II snapshot evidence for the past rolling 30 days (S3 link or report).

Amelia (Acme): attaching the proposed addendum for your review; if it looks OK we'll have it routed for signature via DocuSign (link: https://app.redwood.com/contracts/docusign/RC-98342).

Attachments included: proposed-dpa-addendum-v1.docx
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EdgeCacheIncident

I will follow up with a short note to product & sales to ensure affected accounts are tracked.

-Kim

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: proposed-dpa-addendum-v1.docx (word), SOC2-snapshot-link (url)
